correctness.rationale: The proof identifies a bijection between independent dominating sets of C(G) and cliques of G of size 0, 1, or 2. Each direction is checked for arbitrary finite graphs satisfying triangle-freeness and minimum degree two. The degree-count identities give the full polynomial; a separate direct enumeration of 560 labelled graphs up to six vertices confirms the formula and two degree-sequence counterexamples.

value.rationale: Provides the complete support-size distribution of maximal independent sets for every central graph of a triangle-free original of minimum degree two; an exact and unexpectedly simple total count 1+n+m, minimum-set multiplicity, and an explicit pair showing sensitivity to degree-degree incidence not captured by the original degree sequence. The structural bijection could support further enumeration and comparison of central-graph families, beyond reproducing a minimum-only result.
